summary: Under normal circumstances, the fund will invest at least 80% of its net assets (plus the amount of any borrowings for investment purposes) in a portfolio of U.S. Treasury securities that collectively have an average duration of approximately 3 years, either directly or indirectly (e.g., through derivatives). The index is comprised of certain U.S. Treasury notes and bonds that are included in the Bloomberg U.S. Treasury Index. It is non-diversified.
